To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the model with broken SU (3) symmetry using the fragmentation functions for all the light quarks and a strangeness parameter is a good fit to all LEP data on vector meson production.
we have studied the NLO fragmentation of vector meson octets in e+e- collisions using a model with SU(3) broken symmetry and have obtained good-quality fits to LEP and SLC data for ρ, ω, K* and ϕ.
we have developed a model for the fragmentation of vector meson octets at the NLO in QCD.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the fragmentation of vector meson in the framework of perturbative QCD.
the study of the fragmentation of the vector mesons at NLO using a model with three independent fragmentation functions.
the study of the fragmentation of vector meson at the NLO in QCD.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a model with broken flavour SU(3) can describe the data on vector meson production at the NLO level with a strangeness suppression of about 0:23.
the model with broken SU (3) symmetry and strangeness suppression is able to explain all the vector meson fragmentation functions in the entire kinematical range at NLO.

the NLO QCD model with broken SU3 symmetry, which includes all the light quarks (including s quarks) and the heavy quarks, describes the data for vector meson production at LEP and SLC with good quality.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a model with broken symmetry is able to fit the data at NLO for all the vector mesons of the light octet.
a model with broken symmetry is capable of explaining the data at the NLO for all vector mesons.
this model can be used for any future data on vector mesons and can be easily extended to the heavy quark sector.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the NLO corrections are important for a detailed description of the experimental data and the model is capable of providing a simultaneous description of the vector meson data for a wide range of momentum scales.
the NLO corrections are very large and the cross-sections are enhanced by a factor of 2-3.
the NLO model with broken SU (3) symmetry and strangeness suppression parameter is a good fit to the data.
